units: Ex. R. s. 27 (v. רָהַב) אין ר׳ אלא מלכות rahab means rulership (ref. to Ps. LXXXVII, 4); a. e.

senses.gloss: Rahab, name of the genius of the sea. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 1 את מוצא … ר׳ שמו you will find that the chief of the sea is named Rahab (ref. to Job XXVI, 12); Num. R. s. 18; B. Bath. 74ᵇ; a. e.
